question: In a certain code language, 'EARLY’ is written as 'ZNSCF' and 'GAUGE' is written as 'FIVCH'. How will 'INBOX' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​**Alternately (1) and (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.**

​So,

 
• 'EARLY’ is written as 'ZNSCF'
